domain: Chamonix Valley / Evasion Mont Blanc area
character: Authentic Haute-Savoie village in the Val Montjoie, at the foot of Mont Blanc. Notre-Dame de la Gorge sanctuary (18th-century). 120km linked ski area. Quieter, more traditional alternative to Chamonix.
description: Les Contamines-Montjoie sits in the Val Montjoie at the foot of the Mont Blanc massif. Traditional village with old farmhouses, hamlets, and a peaceful mountain atmosphere. The Notre-Dame de la Gorge sanctuary (18th-century) is a major pilgrimage site. 14 oratories line the approach. Samivel Garden with open-air reproductions of works by the writer/artist. The ski area (120km, 1,200-2,500m) is part of the Evasion Mont Blanc domain but not linked by piste to Megève/Saint-Gervais. Well-known for the Tour du Mont Blanc hiking route passing through.

non_ski_activities.notre_dame_de_la_gorge: 18th-century sanctuary, major pilgrimage site. 14 oratories along approach. Guided visits Thursdays. Starting point for Tour du Mont Blanc hikes, Nant-Borrant, La Balme, Jovet Lakes.
non_ski_activities.samivel_garden: Open-air reproductions of works by Samivel (writer, watercolourist, mountain conservationist) behind the bell tower.
non_ski_activities.baroque_trail: 20km marked route linking Combloux, Saint-Nicolas de Véroce and Notre-Dame de la Gorge via Les Contamines.
non_ski_activities.nature_reserve: Contamines-Montjoie Nature Reserve — spruce forests, peat bogs, alpine pastures, lakes, glaciers. Dogs on leash, no swimming in reserve waters.
non_ski_activities.other: Snowshoeing, cross-country skiing (25km), ski touring, guided heritage walks, swimming

honest_drawbacks: Not linked by piste to Megève/St-Gervais — separate lift pass needed
Lower altitude base — snow variable at season edges
